opening.argument: The video presents a residential plot offer with specific sizes, installment pricing, and a way to arrange a visit or booking. It advertises 80- and 120-square-yard plots, states a monthly installment of 10 thousand, and gives a total price of 10 lakh rupees. The contact request is tied to that property offer, while the aerial view shows roads, open land, and buildings consistent with the subject being advertised. The claimed approval and leased-project status remain unverified. But the material does not establish that those claims are false or that any transaction occurred. On the evidence shown, this is an ordinary real-estate promotion, not an established deception.
